steps: Rinse the rice, soak it in water for 20 to 30 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a pressure cooker and let the bay leaf and cumin sizzle.
Add the sliced onion and fry until light golden.
Add the ginger, garlic, green chilli and tomato, and cook until the tomato is soft.
Stir in all the chopped vegetables and cook them for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the rice, salt and water (about 1 and 3/4 cups for each cup of rice) and bring it to a boil.
Close the lid and cook for 1 whistle, or cover a pot and cook on low heat for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Let it rest for 10 minutes, fluff it gently with a fork and top with coriander leaves.
note: Rice ran from 75 to 97 g a serving, and 90 g suits pulao eaten as the whole meal. Cauliflower comes from one source only and can be swapped for more of the other vegetables.
